items.name: activity-heatmap
items.title: Activity Heatmap
items.description: A year of daily activity as a GitHub-style grid: a column per week, a row per weekday, one square per day, shaded by how much happened.

items.name: approval-card
items.title: Approval Card
items.description: A human-in-the-loop approval surface: one sentence about the call a gate is holding, and Approve or Reject. Rejecting takes an optional note back to the agent.

items.name: question-card
items.title: Question Card
items.description: A human-in-the-loop question surface: single-choice questions with a free-text answer, walked one step at a time, with a step bar that shows what is answered, skipped and still ahead.

items.name: loading-state
items.title: Loading State
items.description: A wait, said once: a 3×3 mark with a diagonal wave, a word for what the agent is doing, and a count of how long it has been.

items.name: attachment
items.title: Attachment
items.description: A square attachment chip for composer rows: image thumbnails, file glyphs and upload progress traced around the card border.

items.name: video-preview
items.title: Video Preview
items.description: A clip you can read before you play it: the whole length on screen as a row of frames, the part you have watched lit, and a press anywhere on it to seek there.

items.name: compare
items.title: Compare
items.description: A before and after in one frame: a divider you drag across two pictures of the same place, so the eye sees what changed instead of remembering it.

items.name: breakdown
items.title: Breakdown
items.description: A whole cut into its parts: one bar, each cut as wide as its share, and a legend that names every part and its amount.

items.name: date-range-picker
items.title: Date Range Picker
items.description: A date range made by name, drawn on two months, or typed: one draft behind all three, a shortcut commits in one press, and OK commits the rest.

items.name: conversation
items.title: Conversation
items.description: The scroll region a transcript lives in: it follows its own tail while the reader is at the end, stops the moment they scroll up, and offers a way back when they have.

items.name: message
items.title: Message
items.description: One turn of a transcript, assembled from parts: who it is from, the body, and the actions that appear once you are done reading.

items.name: scroll-rail
items.title: Scroll Rail
items.description: A tick rail that mirrors a long scroll region: width carries distance from the reading line, colour carries focus. Hover a tick to preview the turn, click to jump to it.

items.name: aspect-ratio-picker
items.title: Aspect Ratio Picker
items.description: Aspect ratio as a grid of to-scale glyphs, each drawn inside the same square window so the shapes line up and the ratio reads without the label.

items.name: resolution-segmented
items.title: Resolution Segmented
items.description: A segmented resolution control with a sliding plate and a dot-matrix glyph that carries sampling density: two dots standard, three high, four retina.

items.name: provider-mark
items.title: Provider Mark
items.description: One maker's logo at 20px, in the colour the brand draws it: twenty-three marks, taken from LobeHub's icon set and inlined so a picker never pays for an icon package.

items.name: model-select
items.title: Model Select
items.description: A catalogue you can walk: what is recommended first, then every maker in one scroll, with a rail that indexes the list and follows you down it.

items.name: duration-slider
items.title: Duration Slider
items.description: Duration as a compact clip on a timeline: drag the playhead, read the live value in a HUD, commit one settled number on release.

items.name: strength-select
items.title: Strength Select
items.description: Strength as a track you drag: one seat per level, the playhead riding the fill's leading edge, and a slow drift of motes across the fill of the top level.

items.name: thinking-block
items.title: Thinking Block
items.description: A collapsible window onto a reasoning stream: a capped height, a mask that says there is more below, and a follow that lets the newest line rise into place instead of jumping the scroll.

items.name: agent-activity
items.title: Agent Activity
items.description: A run as one thing: the wait while it goes, one line once it is over, and the steps it took folded behind that line for the reader who doubts the answer.

items.name: context-usage
items.title: Context Usage
items.description: How much of the model's window is spent: a ring small enough for a composer, and behind it a bar cut by what fills the window, with the track left showing for what is still free.

items.name: queue
items.title: Queue
items.description: Messages the user sent while the agent was running: what is waiting, in the order the agent will take it, and a way to take one back.

items.name: source
items.title: Source
items.description: A page the agent leans on, as a small tag: a mark and the host it lives on, a link out, with the page's title on hover.

items.name: tool-call
items.title: Tool Call
items.description: One call, one row: the name, the gist of what it was given, where it stands, and the arguments and result behind a disclosure for the reader who doubts the line.

items.name: generation-overlay
items.title: Generation Overlay
items.description: The overlay a media node wears while it generates: a two-tone flow drifting behind the result, a blur-to-focus reveal once the media decodes, and a failure line when it never arrives.

items.name: flow-edge
items.title: Flow Edge
items.description: A bezier connector that carries a pulse of light from one end to the other while work is in flight — bright in the middle, faded at both ends — and rests as a plain line when it is not.

items.name: settings-dialog
items.title: Settings Dialog
items.description: Destinations down the left, one panel on the right: a rail you can walk with the arrow keys, a panel that fades in, and the row, section and card the panel is built from.

items.name: prompt-input
items.title: Prompt Input
items.description: The box a message is written in, assembled from parts: a field that grows and then scrolls, the files riding with the draft as chips above it, the model answering it, and the one button that ends the turn. Swap the field for the editor and @ mentions and / commands become chips in the draft.

items.name: cover-fan
items.title: Cover Fan
items.description: A fan of cover cards for an empty state: full-bleed art, the title sitting on it, and enough of every card left showing that the whole set reads in one look. Hover lifts a card out of the fan.

items.name: skill-detail
items.title: Skill Detail
items.description: A skill's detail surface: a card that opens it, and a panel that says what it is, what it is for, and what is inside it. A cover rail with the name and the one action over it, then a workspace of what the skill makes and a file tree whose preview is your renderer — with only the toolbar controls you wired up.

items.name: voice-input
items.title: Voice Input
items.description: A composer's mic. A press asks for the microphone and the composer becomes a recording bar: cancel on the left, the live level across the middle, stop on the right. The level is written straight to the DOM, so a sixty-frame meter never re-renders anything.

items.name: agent-run
items.title: Agent Run
items.description: A whole agent run for a page: a thread that follows its own tail, turns that carry reasoning, tool calls and approvals, and a composer that holds files and a model. Assembled from conversation, message, agent-activity, tool-call, source, approval-card, question-card, loading-state, context-usage and prompt-input.

items.name: generation-canvas
items.title: Generation Canvas
items.description: A canvas you can work in: bare picture and clip frames with a plus at each side, edges that say which frame starts from which and carry light while a result is on its way, and a composer under the plane that writes the prompt and settings of whichever frame is selected. Built on @xyflow/react; what a run does is a function you pass.
